problem.statement: Foodsoft's cooperative order-balancing UI can flag false mismatches when article quantities are rounded to three decimals but the summed group-order quantities are not.

sources.claim: Issue #1368 reports an explicit unit rounding discrepancy and a minimal code-location lead; this is software maintainer feedback, not proof of demand for paid consulting.

repository.description: Nonprofit food cooperative software for product ordering, cooperative accounting and job scheduling.

fit.documented_capability: Foodsoft supports member group orders and accounting/balancing views with a quantity-difference diagnostic.
fit.problem_requirement: Price and quantity reconciliation must compare values consistently at the same precision without suppressing real order mismatches.
fit.unverified_gap: Issue #1368 identifies a precision mismatch; a safe fix and regression fixture still need to be executed. No contract or local deployment demand is confirmed.

market.buyer_segment: Foodsoft maintainer community or cooperatives experiencing balancing errors

signals.claim: An unresolved published issue documents a software quality need, not spending authority or a purchase request.
Foodsoft publicly invites contributors and participation in its community development activities; this is not a paid implementation request.
Unassigned open issue #1368 is an actionable contribution candidate; the maintainer has not contracted our work.
